subject: FairWind renewal — exec approval needed for retention package
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FairWind renewal — exec approval needed for retention package

Team,

FairWind's renewal (annual, current TCV $1.2M) is due 2028-06-30 and is at risk — procurement has signaled they are evaluating an alternate provider on price. Key facts: 6% YoY usage decline, but platform reliance is high (300K requests/day). They’re asking for a 25% concession across seats and an extended term to justify continued investment.

What I'm recommending to keep the account:
- 15% recurring discount on platform fees for a 12-month reset (effectively a one-time term reset to reprice)
- One-time operational credit of $75,000 against next invoice
- SLA add-on: 99.9% uptime SLA with a 30-day response promise for Sev1s for the first 6 months

Attachments: fairwind-usage-report-q1-2028.pdf (behavior/consumption), proposed-amendment-fairwind-2028.docx (tracked changes), concession-summary-worksheet.xlsx (financial impact).

Ask: need executive authorization to offer the above (or counter) by EOD today so I can get legal/procurement the redline for DocuSign. If you prefer a different mix (larger credit, smaller discount, or additional term), tell me now.

Why this is urgent: They are budget-constrained but highly embedded. Losing them would open a strategic vertical gap we’ve worked to build.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
M: (415) 555-0192

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FairWind renewal — exec approval needed for retention package

Maya — thanks for the summary and the files. Quick thoughts:

- I support a concession to keep them, but 15% recurring + $75k credit looks borderline versus their ask. Suggest we offer two options to present to the customer (short, clear):
  Option A (preferred): 15% recurring discount + $75k one-time credit + SLA add-on (99.9%): faster legal turnaround, caps our downside
  Option B (competitive): 20% recurring discount + $40k one-time credit, 12-month term reset (no SLA add-on)

- We should be explicit on the max total concession in TCV terms. From finance side, anything >$150k impact needs CFO nod.

- Can legal turn around the attached amendment with tracked changes in 24 hours if we get a sign-off? If yes, I’ll queue it and draft the acceptance language.

Quoted for context:
> Maya Srinivasan wrote:
> > FairWind's renewal (annual, current TCV $1.2M) is due 2028-06-30 and is at risk...
> > Attachments: fairwind-usage-report-q1-2028.pdf, proposed-amendment-fairwind-2028.docx, concession-summary-worksheet.xlsx

Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 12:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FairWind renewal — exec approval needed for retention package

I reviewed the numbers. Approve a firm fallback we can present immediately:

Final approved concession (authorized):
- 15% recurring discount for 12 months (term reset)
- One-time operational credit: $75,000
- SLA add-on: 99.9% uptime, with 30-day Sev1 response guarantee for first 6 months

Conditions:
1) Customer must execute the attached amendment on DocuSign within 10 business days of receipt.
2) Total expected concession impact cannot exceed $200,000 TCV; if final finance calc exceeds $200k, pause and escalate to CFO (David).
3) Legal to confirm liability language in the SLA add-on and limit penalty exposure.

Neha — please route the amendment to legal and procurement; David, please pre-clear finance for up to $200k impact so we don’t delay.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@fairwind.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Bryant <aisha@fairwind.ai>, procure@fairwind.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FairWind renewal — exec approval needed for retention package

Thanks, Maya and team — we appreciate the quick engagement. Our CFO and procurement reviewed both options and we prefer the mix you outlined in Option A (discount + credit + SLA). Two items before we sign:

1) Please confirm the SLA wording includes a bilateral force majeure carveout and that the credit is non-refundable and applied to the next invoice.
2) We’ll need the DocuSign link and the final amendment with tracked changes; procurement wants to see the DocuSign flow and an expected execution date.

We are prepared to execute within the 10 business days if the amendment reflects the approved terms above.

Jordan Ellis
Head of Platform Ops | FairWind
jordan.ellis@fairwind.ai
Phone: (617) 555-2234
